I fixed the Household expenses page. I haven't opened it to check it renders, so please take a look.

The page code had two bugs:
- **Wrong table reference:** it looked up `note.table`, but the correct name is `note.tables`. This error stopped the page from drawing anything.
- **Amount column not recognised:** it only treated columns named Amount, Cost, Price and similar as the amount. Your column is named "Amt", so I added that name to the list.

I only edited the page. Your note's table is unchanged. The previous version of the page is kept if you want to go back to it.
